title: replybridge - channel-agnostic inbound reply router with fail-closed escalation

limits: No live provider calls were made; outbound transport is injected in tests
Provider webhook registration and app review are out of scope for this sample
One vendor endpoint is marked unverified in code because no official document was located
Single sqlite writer; multi-replica deployment needs a different store
No independent third-party crosscheck has been performed on this work yet
Guardrail keyword lists in config are localised sample data for a Chinese-language inbound channel; they contain no client content
The console is read/write over plain HTTP on localhost only; it is not an authenticated admin surface
verification.console_ui: server-rendered console at / : decision log, human queue with approve-and-send, escalation breakdown, hash-chain integrity badge, light/dark theme
